**OBSERVATIONAL ONLY** — touches nothing: not paper, not the ledger, not frozen_v1, not labels, not criteria. Directional fires only; same fires as the signal scoreboard. **Honest-fill rules (operator-ruled, part of every recipe's definition):** (1) both reachable -> stop always; (2) gap -> gapped (worse) price; (3) composed/trailing stops ratchet only, settled bars; (4) EOD flat at native session close.
